title: Video by blooodyuki
description:
The hammer lands and the whole floor SCREAMS with lightning ⚡️
Every arc crawling across the tiles, every spark burst, every rune circle igniting under the blow. I layered electric crackle, deep sub impacts and sizzling debris so each strike feels like Thor himself just showed up 🔨
Sound design by SH Jo, and this lightning charged hammer is pure power. That ghostly lightning wolf running through the frame? Absolute chills.
Wait for the final slam, where four pillars of storm light erupt at once and the runes burn through the smoke 💥
What sound would YOU give this hammer? Drop it in the comments 👇
鎚が床に落ちた瞬間、タイルの床全体が稲妻で悲鳴を上げる ⚡️
床を這い回る放電、はじける火花、打撃の下で灯りだすルーンの魔法陣。電気のビリビリと深い重低音のインパクト、パチパチと崩れる瓦礫を重ねて、まるで雷神その人が降臨したような一撃に仕上げた 🔨
SH Jo のサウンドデザインが宿る稲妻の鎚、その威力は圧倒的。画面を駆け抜ける稲妻の狼は鳥肌モノ。
最後の一撃で4本の嵐の光の柱が一斉に噴き上がり、煙の中でルーンが燃え上がる瞬間を見逃すな 💥
あなたならこの鎚にどんな音を合わせる？コメントで教えて 👇
#sounddesigner #gameaudio #vfx #サウンドデザイン #効果音

title: Video by blooodyuki
description:
This blood witch animation by @설천g8q is absolutely insane! 🩸✨ She rises from a literal pool of blood and shoots blood arrows to destroy her enemies! The visuals are so epic and brutal.
Want to know a crazy secret about the audio? 🤫 To create those incredibly squishy and impactful blood sounds I actually smashed some carrots and eggplants right in the studio! 🥕🍆 Foley is pure magic. You hear brutal blood spells but I am just destroying veggies behind the mic!
Can you hear the eggplant in the final mix? Tell me in the comments! 👇
@설천g8q さんのこの血の魔女アニメーション、マジでヤバすぎる！🩸✨ 血の池から現れて、血の矢で敵を粉砕するんだ！ビジュアルが最高にエピック。
音響の秘密を知りたい？🤫 あの超リアルで強烈な血の音を作るために、実はスタジオでニンジンとナスを潰しまくったんだ！🥕🍆 映像では残酷な血の魔法の音が聞こえるけど、マイクの裏ではひたすら野菜を叩いてるだけ！音作りって本当に魔法みたいでしょ？
完成した動画からナスの音が聞こえる？ぜひコメントで教えてね！👇
#sounddesigner #sounddesign #foley #サウンドデザイン #効果音

title: Video by blooodyuki
description:
Turn up your volume right now 🎧 Just look at this mindblowing animation by @marimo0_0! A samurai literally slicing through time and space with a single katana strike 🗡️ The VFX is just off the charts! I had to match that crazy visual energy with the sound. To create that dimensional tear I layered heavy bass impacts with sharp metallic ringing and a deep whoosh effect 🌌 You can physically feel the fabric of reality ripping apart! Listen closely to the sword slash. What do you think of this audio vibe? Drop a comment below! 👇
今すぐ音量を上げて 🎧 @marimo0_0 によるこの驚異的なアニメーションを見てください！サムライが一本の刀で時空間を切り裂く瞬間 🗡️ VFXのクオリティが限界突破しています！このヤバい映像のエネルギーに負けないようなサウンドを作りました。次元の裂け目を表現するために重低音の衝撃波と鋭い金属音そして深い風切り音を重ねています 🌌 現実の空間が引き裂かれる感覚を体感できるはず！刀を振り抜く音に耳を傾けてみてください。このサウンドの雰囲気どう思いますか？ぜひコメントで教えてください！ 👇

One samurai. One katana. **ONE** strike. Boss deleted. ⚔️🔥

Rnek4919 went absolutely wild with this animation! A samurai in total control of his power, a devastating slash, and VFX that make every moment hit harder.

title: Video by porsukgames
description:
Your attacks work... but they feel like hitting wet cardboard? ⚔️💥

 Here are 5 steps (+ 1 bonus) to make combat feel INSANELY satisfying:

 1️⃣ Hit-Flash & Squash: Blink the enemy pure white and squash their silhouette on impact.
 2️⃣ Knockback & Hitstop: Freeze the frame for 3–5 frames and shove them back. Instant weight.
 3️⃣ Layered Crunch: Add punchy bass and scale the pitch up with consecutive combo hits.
 4️⃣ Slash Arcs & Sparks: Directional crescent sweeps and high-velocity spark bursts.
 5️⃣ Dynamic Health Bar: Bouncy floating damage numbers + a delayed white catch-up trail.
 ⭐ BONUS: Crit multipliers & 3D shatter explosions on the finisher!

 💾 SAVE this reel to polish your game’s combat mechanics later!
 💬 Drop a comment: What mechanic should we juice up next?

 Follow @porsukgames for daily game feel & dev breakdowns! 🕹️

title: Video by goodgood3d
description:
Swear I use the same 5 nodes for 90% of my 3D work. These stylised visual effects are no different. But the difficult thing about them isn’t technical, it’s getting the timing and colours right. When it comes to that, I’m a rookie. If you want a real masterclass check out @arthurmunozanimation

All of my experiments so far use either a noise or voronoi texture. I’ve stopped animating the W input on 4D textures altogether in favour of the mapping node (location is especially useful) - It’s much cheaper and translates better to game engines. or so I’m learning. I’ve also started to lean toward ‘less is more’ for individual materials while layering effects is where you make all the difference. 

If you want to download some of my recent experiments, or watch a longer tutorial, consider supporting me on Patreon.

title: Video by blooodyuki
description:
This VFX animation by @yatsenko.denisss , founder of More VFX Academy, looks absolutely insane 🤯

The movement is gorgeous, the timing feels razor sharp, and that final explosion hits like a truck 💥 I wanted the sound to follow the visual energy with deep impacts, sharp transitions, rising tension, and a massive blast at the end.

That last explosion is the moment. Turn up the volume and listen closely 🔊 What sound would you add to make it feel even more powerful?

Denis Yatsenko氏が手がけたこのVFXアニメーションは、本当に圧倒的です 🤯

More VFX Academyの創設者でもある彼の作品は、動きが美しく、タイミングも鋭く、最後の爆発はまるで画面から飛び出してくるような迫力です 💥

映像のエネルギーに合わせて、深いインパクト音、鋭いトランジション、緊張感のある上昇音、そして最後に巨大な爆発音を加えました。

最後の爆発は必聴です。音量を上げて、細かい音まで聴いてみてください 🔊 さらに迫力を出すなら、どんな音を加えますか？
